records.english: {HEX:06}Doing well so far?{LB}Now let's discuss navigators:{LB}that means us.{PAD}
{HEX:06}Assign each navigator a role{LB}for smoother voyages.{LB}We'll do that{LB}on the deck screen.{PAD}
{HEX:06}To begin, FI is captain.{LB}A ship cannot move{LB}without a captain,{LB}of course.{PAD}
{HEX:06}Next, the sail master.{LB}They adjust sails to the wind.{LB}You need one{LB}for each mast.{PAD}
{HEX:06}Then the helmsman.{LB}Vital when you need{LB}a ship to turn quickly.{PAD}
{HEX:06}A skilled helmsman{LB}moves the ship quickly{LB}to an advantageous position{LB}in battle.{PAD}
{HEX:06}Next, the mate.{LB}The ship moves without one,{LB}but a mate aids negotiations{LB}and reduces crew fatigue.{PAD}
{HEX:06}A surveyor enables Auto Move{LB}and shows the fleet's{LB}latitude and longitude.{PAD}
{HEX:06}The lookout reports ships{LB}and city conditions at sea.{PAD}
{HEX:06}These roles are enough{LB}for a normal voyage.{LB}Experiment with the rest.{PAD}
{HEX:FE}Press X, then choose{LB}Deck View from the menu.{LB}There you can change{LB}navigator assignments.{PAD}
